headline: DataAnnotation Review: Jobs, Pay & Application Process (2026)
description: DataAnnotation.tech review covering roles, pay, onboarding, and what makes this platform a common entry point for AI conversation rating work.

acceptedAnswer.text: A platform offering on-demand AI conversation rating, data annotation, and response evaluation tasks, with no degree required and weekly PayPal payments.
Yes, payments are processed weekly via PayPal.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a degree for DataAnnotation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, a degree is not required, though writing quality is tested during onboarding.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between DataAnnotation and Outlier AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: DataAnnotation documents only a writing quality check at onboarding; Outlier AI uses a General Reasoning Screening that requires 80% or more.
